name: jMouse CAD
summary: An electronics engine: one jM language for every document — symbols, footprints, components, circuits, boards —, a live and a batch simulator, and plugins for whatever the core does not do itself.

roadmap.title: The engine on its own
items: One jM language for every document, read and written as a tree, never as text
A live and a batch simulator over the same circuit, measured against ngspice
Parts are components of the library: no primitives, every value written as the component names it
Sheets placed as blocks, each tuned on its own while the circuit runs

roadmap.title: Plugins
items: A plugin brings what the core reads and nothing else: formats, engines, places to look for parts
SPICE with ngspice, KiCad, Nexar — plugins, each switched off without the rest noticing

roadmap.title: Explorer
items: A server folder mounted as a library: browse, open, rename and keep files beside the projects
Every file opened by whatever plugin reads its kind

roadmap.title: Plugins in the interface
items: Buttons, menu entries and panels contributed by plugins, not written into the screens
The formats and engines offered from what the server runs

roadmap.title: 3D
items: A part's body as a 3D model, seated on its footprint
The board in 3D: copper, mask, silkscreen and every part, exported as STEP

roadmap.title: Fabrication
items: A board sent to JLCPCB: Gerber, drill, bill of materials and placement, with its price
Symbols, footprints and models found at Component Search Engine, UltraLibrarian and SnapEDA
